answers.drew: I’ve always been super drawn to anything pop culture or celebrity since I was a kid. I’ve absolutely adored everything from how creative ideas are brought to life through visual or audio mediums. I have especially adored the concept of a celebrity or talent and their image or how they interact with the public.
answers.seeking: I just want to connect and learn from others who share similar goals as me and have different perspective from this industry. I really want a holistic understanding of the entertainment industry.
answers.inspiration: I don’t know if this is unconventional but a huge recent inspiration of mine is actually Brittany Broski. The way she was able to turn her social media influence into something that holds a much bigger place in not just the influencer zeitgeist but in the entertainment industry has just been awesome. She has really shone that traditional methods are not just how you achieve your dream and I just adore her work ethic.
